text: ‘The provision of foreign aid by wealthier nations is motivated as much by self-interest as by a
desire to help.’ Assess this view. [30]
‘The hunting of wild animals should be discouraged.’ Discuss.
‘Education is the most important factor in increasing social and economic opportunities.’ To what
extent do you agree? [30]
To what extent is knowledge of the past a good guide to future events?
Computer hacking is the greatest threat for the communication of information on the internet.
Discuss. [30]
Assess the advantages and disadvantages of free health care for all. [30]
‘It is more desirable to live in a city than in a rural area.’ To what extent do you agree?
‘Autobiographies are more reliable than biographies.’ To what extent do you agree?
‘National celebrations, rather than uniting people, can divide them.’ To what extent do you agree
with reference to your country? [30]
Evaluate the importance of the live music and/or theatre experience for both performer and
audience. [30]
